title: My Stepdaughter Stole My $88K Studio And Sold It For $380K. So I Let Her Clean Cat Hair.
description: I poured my $88,000 nursing pension into a pet-portrait studio with my stepdaughter, securing a 45% share. She forged an ownership transfer, sold the viral accounts and client list for $380,000, and sent me a $2,000 check. Now she cleans cat hair in a 'Paws-itively Guilty' shirt while every receipt prints her perjury conviction number. #Karma #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal
thumb_text: NOW SHE CLEANS CAT HAIR IN A PAWSITIVELY GUILTY SHIRT
pinned_comment: My stepdaughter thought a $2,000 check would make me forget the $88,000 I invested. If someone you trusted forged your business away and then offered you pocket change, what would you have done? Share your story below.

thumb_lines.text: SHE FORGOT I TAUGHT HER CLOUD BACKUPS AND NURSE DOCUMENTATION
